verdict.rationale: Weave's own marketing says signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions in the background, and that alerts can trigger webhook automations. These are product-side automations, but they appear only in thin marketing copy, with no docs on how to configure, schedule, or manage them. The 'automatic iteration loops' are run by external coding agents through MCP and Skills, so they get no credit here. Missing for 10: documented automation setup and configuration, recurring schedules or trigger definitions, run history and management of background jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
Alerts route what matters through Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations, turning every production insight into a fast iteration.
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
